name: Fantasy Formula
source:
You just moved into your own apartment, and found a job at the city mall! Congratulations!

Your manager... or... managers... are a bit of an odd bunch though... every new manager you meet has some odd personality that you have to work around and make your way in this new, fast-paced, and heated story!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3952490/Fantasy_Formula/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚搬进自己的公寓，并在城市购物中心找到了工作！恭喜！

你的经理……或……经理们……有点奇怪……你遇到的每一位新经理都有一些奇怪的个性，你必须解决这些个性，并在这个新的、快节奏的、激烈的故事中找到自己的路！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3952490/Fantasy_Formula/]Steam[/url]]
